Title: 498953-2026: France – Civil engineering and building works – RD 900 AVIGNON - Redevelopment of the Bonpas interchange - Lot No 12: Structure CAN 2 + Walls + Noise barrier on structure and walls
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Road/bridge project (structure CAN2) with ramps, retaining walls and noise protection, fits our interest in road and civil engineering structures; deduction because the project is in France and spans/complexity are not apparent.
titel: RD 900 Avignon – Redevelopment of the Bonpas interchange – Lot No. 12: Structure CAN 2, retaining walls and noise barrier
kurzbeschreibung: Award of construction works for the structure OA CAN 2 with ramps, retaining walls M1 and M2 including sliding bearings as well as a noise barrier as part of the redevelopment of the Bonpas interchange on the RD 900 in Avignon.
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works (open procedure, no design competition)
gewinner: 4M MEREU BTP (lead of the consortium), 4M PROVENCE ROUTE, BUESA TP, MATIÈRE, MIDI TRAVAUX
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies / consortium for construction works

relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Road bridge/civil engineering structure with noise barrier, generally within the sbp scope of services
- Pure construction contract; structural design has already been carried out and is not part of the notice
- Medium-sized regional project in France, without indication of special spans or exceptional structural concepts
- No architectural or design competition, therefore no approach to contact the winner for planning cooperation
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project location France, checking engineer services according to the German system not applicable
- Construction contract already awarded, no separate tender for structural checking or independent control apparent
- Medium project size, but no indications of particular complexity or international control requirements
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the notice: value of all contracts awarded for Lot 12 = 3 848 900 EUR, plausible as construction costs for the structure and associated components
naechste_schritte: No active steps required. Project to be documented internally only as a reference for French road bridge construction contracts; no contact planned for structural design or checking engineer services.
notes: Lot 12 comprises the structure OA CAN 2 with ramps, retaining walls M1/M2, sliding bearings and noise barrier as part of the redevelopment of the Bonpas interchange on the RD 900. It is a pure construction contract with a single electronically submitted bid. Award criteria: 50% price, 50% quality. No indications of planning services or competition character; structural design is likely already completed. Company MATIÈRE is known as a major bridge builder and may be of long-term interest as an industrial partner, but this specific project offers few points of approach.
